continuation_mismatch.description: Mean mismatch between predicted and observed continuation state.
continuation_mismatch.expected_behavior: Lower under admissible reinforced continuation than under shuffled or ablated controls.

phase_error.description: Angular error between phase continuation target and realized phase.
phase_error.expected_behavior: Bounded during valid disconnect and reduced during recouple.

survivability_decision.expected_behavior: Reject or hold under mismatch, low Signal X, and adversarial stress.

operator_path.description: Sequence of selected operators from the orientation family.
operator_path.expected_behavior: Settles under stable continuation and destabilizes under primitive suppression.

phase_locking_value.description: Phase consistency measure across train, disconnect, and recouple protocols.
phase_locking_value.expected_behavior: Degrades under shuffle control and remains bounded only when continuation is genuinely internal.

trajectory_alignment.description: Alignment score between expected and realized continuation trajectory.
trajectory_alignment.expected_behavior: Higher in valid continuation than ablated or shuffled controls.
